intro: Deliver the Thread is an Alliance errand in Duskwood that ferries a spool of Ghost Hair Thread from Madame Eva in Darkshire across the haunted forest to Abercrombie. The eccentric hermit living near Raven Hill Cemetery claims he needs the enchanted thread to ward his ramshackle hut against restless spirits. However, Madame Eva's dark remarks about the thread hint that there may be far more sinister uses for it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is your thread, friend. It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits. Did you get it for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here, good friend, take this as payment for your honorable deed.
